## Understanding the hourly to annual conversion

When you have an hourly rate or a salary offer, the simplest way to compare them is to convert one to the other. For a full-time role, the standard formula is:

**Annual gross pay = hourly rate × hours per week × 52**

This article assumes a 38-hour week, which is the ordinary hours used by the Fair Work Commission for the National Minimum Wage. If you work fewer or more hours, adjust the number accordingly. The result is your gross annual pay before tax, super, and other deductions.

To see your fortnightly pay, multiply your weekly pay by two. For example, the National Minimum Wage gives a weekly rate of $1,004.90 (38 hours × $26.44), so a fortnight is $2,009.80.

## National Minimum Wage vs Award Rates

The National Minimum Wage is the legal minimum for employees not covered by an award or agreement. From 1 July 2026, it is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 for a 38-hour week. Casual employees receive a 25% loading, making it $33.05 per hour.

However, most employees are covered by an award – a legally binding document that sets minimum pay rates, allowances, and penalty rates for a specific industry or occupation. For example, a marketing manager may fall under the Clerks – Private Sector Award or the Professional Employees Award, depending on their duties and qualifications. Award rates are typically higher than the National Minimum Wage.

The Fair Work Ombudsman publishes [pay guides](/blog) for each award, which include the minimum hourly rates for each classification level. These guides are the authoritative source for checking what you should be paid. The Fair Work Commission also provides the National Minimum Wage Order and special minimum wages for juniors, apprentices, and employees with disability.

When using a salary guide marketing manager australia, always cross-check the figures against the relevant award or enterprise agreement. Recruiter surveys can be useful, but the legal minimums come from the Fair Work Ombudsman and the Fair Work Commission.

## Casual loading and super

If you are a casual employee, your hourly rate includes a 25% casual loading. This compensates for not receiving paid leave (annual leave, personal leave). The loading is calculated on top of the base rate. For the National Minimum Wage, that means $33.05 per hour. For an award classification, the loading is also 25% on top of the award base rate.

Superannuation guarantee is separate: your employer must pay 12% of your ordinary time earnings into a super fund, on top of your gross pay. This is not deducted from your wage. The maximum contribution base for the 2026–27 year is $270,830. So if your annual earnings exceed that, the employer only pays super on the first $270,830.

## How the salary guide marketing manager australia fits in

A salary guide marketing manager australia helps you benchmark offers and negotiate. It typically shows median or average salaries for marketing roles across different cities and experience levels. But remember: these guides are not legal minimums. They are market surveys. To ensure you are being paid fairly, start with the award rate for your classification, then consider market data.

For example, the ABS Average Weekly Earnings for full-time adult ordinary time employees was $2,083.70 per week in May 2026. That translates to about $108,352 per year for a 38-hour week. A marketing manager might earn above or below that depending on industry and location.

Use our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) calculator to estimate your net income after tax and Medicare. The 2026–27 resident tax rates are: nil up to $18,200; 15% from $18,201 to $45,000; 30% from $45,001 to $135,000; 37% from $135,001 to $190,000; and 45% above $190,000. Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income.

## Important note about this estimate

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.
